title: Independently verify the original ARM64 splits
acceptance: A second contributor verifies the base APK, ARM64 split and engine fingerprints using their own local copy and records the tool/version used.

title: Describe what the local ARM64 analysis ELF preserves
acceptance: Publish a short reproducible note distinguishing the packaged ELF, runtime snapshot and analysis ELF using hashes and segment coverage only.

title: Build a synthetic long-replay drift fixture
acceptance: Detect an injected discontinuity at 16 km and pass a continuous control trajectory. Use generated coordinates with no game frames or assets.

title: Document fixture classification edge cases
acceptance: Record observations and their confidence for camera zones, gravity zones, decorative regions and floating roads in an independently reproducible checklist.

title: Verify repeatable object builds on two machines
acceptance: Compile an original contributor-owned ARM64 fixture twice with pinned flags and compare its object files using the exact-byte checker. Record compiler and flags.
